arxiv-1705-03831.title: Quasi-Reliable Estimates of Effective Sample Size
arxiv-1705-03831.creator: Youhan Fang, Yudong Cao, Robert D. Skeel
arxiv-1705-03831.description: Abstract The efficiency of a Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm might be measured by the cost of generating one independent sample, or equivalently, the total cost divided by the effective sample size, defined in terms of the integrated autocorrelation time.

arxiv-2001-03723.title: Reentrant spin reorientation transition and Griffiths – \textendash like phase in antiferromagnetic TbFe 0.5 Cr 0.5 O 3
arxiv-2001-03723.creator: Bhawana Mali, Harikrishnan S. Nair, T. W. Heitmann, Hariharan Nhalil, Daniel Antonio, Krzysztof Gofryk, Shalika Ram Bhandari, Madhav Prasad Ghimire, Suja Elizabeth
arxiv-2001-03723.description: Abstract The perovskite TbFe 0.5 Cr 0.5 O 3 shows two anomalies in the magnetic susceptibility at T N T_{N} = 257 K and T SR T_{\mathrm{SR}} = 190 K which are respectively, the antiferromagnetic and spin reorientation transition that occur in the Fe/Cr sublattice.

arxiv-2001-11841.title: Learning Perception and Planning with Deep Active Inference
arxiv-2001-11841.creator: Ozan Çatal, Tim Verbelen, Johannes Nauta, Cedric De Boom, Bart Dhoedt
arxiv-2001-11841.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Ozan Çatal, Tim Verbelen, Johannes Nauta, Cedric De Boom, Bart Dhoedt. Active inference is a process theory of the brain that states that all living organisms infer actions in order to minimize their (expected) free energy. However, current experiments are limited to predefined, often discrete, state spaces. In this paper we use recent advances in deep learning to learn the state space and approximate the necessary probability distributions to engage in active inference.

arxiv-2101-05975.title: Multi-layer Feature Fusion Convolutional Network for Audio-visual Speech Enhancement
arxiv-2101-05975.creator: Xinmeng Xu, Jianjun Hao
arxiv-2101-05975.description: Abstract Speech enhancement can potentially benefit from the visual information from the target speaker, such as lip movement and facial expressions, because the visual aspect of speech is essentially unaffected by acoustic environment. In this paper, we address the problem of enhancing corrupted speech signal from videos by using audio-visual (AV) neural processing.

arxiv-2110-00170.title: Surveillance Testing for Rapid Detection of Outbreaks in Facilities
arxiv-2110-00170.creator: Yanyue Ding, Sudesh K. Agrawal, Jincheng Cao, Lauren Meyers, John J. Hasenbein
arxiv-2110-00170.description: Abstract This paper develops an agent-based disease spread model on a contact network in an effort to guide efforts at surveillance testing in small to moderate facilities such as nursing homes and meat-packing plants. The model employs Monte Carlo simulations of viral spread sample paths in the contact network.

arxiv-2111-05503.title: Active Galactic Nuclei Abundance in Cosmic Voids Journal: ApJL
arxiv-2111-05503.creator: Hora D. Mishra, Xinyu Dai, Eduardo Guerras
arxiv-2111-05503.description: Abstract The abundance of active galactic nuclei (AGN) in cosmic voids is relatively unexplored in the literature, but can potentially provide new constraints on the environmental dependence of AGN activity and the AGN-host co-evolution. We investigated AGN fraction in one of the largest samples of optically selected cosmic voids from SDSS Data Release 12 for redshift range 0.2 − 0.

arxiv-2202-00598.title: Combined Pruning for Nested Cross-Validation to Accelerate Automated Hyperparameter Optimization for Embedded Feature Selection in High-Dimensional Data with Very Small Sample Sizes
arxiv-2202-00598.creator: S.M.Sigrun May, S.H.Sven Hartmann, F.K.Frank Klawonn
arxiv-2202-00598.description: Abstract \parttitle Background Embedded feature selection in high-dimensional data with very small sample sizes requires optimized hyperparameters for the model building process. For this hyperparameter optimization, nested cross-validation must be applied to avoid a biased performance estimation. The resulting repeated training with high-dimensional data leads to very long computation times.

arxiv-2202-03043.title: Dynamics of rotation in chiral nuclei
arxiv-2202-03043.creator: Z. X. Ren gbsn (任政学), P. W. Zhao gbsn(赵鹏巍), J. Meng gbsn(孟杰)
arxiv-2202-03043.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Z. X. Ren gbsn (任政学), P. W. Zhao gbsn(赵鹏巍), J. Meng gbsn(孟杰). The dynamics of chiral nuclei is investigated for the first time with the time-dependent and tilted axis cranking covariant density functional theories on a three-dimensional space lattice in a microscopic and self-consistent way. The experimental energies of the two pairs of the chiral doublet bands in 135 Nd are well reproduced without any adjustable parameters beyond the well-defined density functional.

arxiv-2205-06308.title: An Equivalence Principle for the Spectrum of Random Inner-Product Kernel Matrices with Polynomial Scalings
arxiv-2205-06308.creator: Yue M. Lu and Horng-Tzer Yau
arxiv-2205-06308.description: Abstract We investigate random matrices whose entries are obtained by applying a nonlinear kernel function to pairwise inner products between n n independent data vectors, drawn uniformly from the unit sphere in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} . This study is motivated by applications in machine learning and statistics, where these kernel random matrices and their spectral properties play significant roles.

arxiv-2206-01625.title: Correcting the B A B_{A} coalescence factor at GSI-HADES and RHIC-BES energies
arxiv-2206-01625.creator: Apiwit Kittiratpattana 1,4 , Tom Reichert 1,3 , Jan Steinheimer 5 , Christoph Herold 4 , Ayut Limphirat 4 , Yupeng Yan 4 , Marcus Bleicher 1,2,3
arxiv-2206-01625.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Apiwit Kittiratpattana 1,4 , Tom Reichert 1,3 , Jan Steinheimer 5 , Christoph Herold 4 , Ayut Limphirat 4 , Yupeng Yan 4 , Marcus Bleicher 1,2,3. We investigate the coalescence factors B 2 B_{2} and B 3 B_{3} at low collision energies ( s NN < 6 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}<6 GeV) with special focus on the HADES and RHIC-BES experiments.

arxiv-2206-13820.title: Joint reconstructions of growth and expansion histories from Stage-IV surveys with minimal assumptions I: Dark Energy beyond Λ \Lambda
arxiv-2206-13820.creator: Rodrigo Calderón, Benjamin L’Huillier, David Polarski, Arman Shafieloo, Alexei A. Starobinsky
arxiv-2206-13820.description: Abstract Combining Supernovae, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Redshift-Space Distortions data from the next generation of (Stage-IV) cosmological surveys, we aim to reconstruct the expansion history up to large redshifts using forward-modeling of f DE ​ ( z ) = ρ DE ​ ( z ) / ρ DE , 0 f_{\mathrm{DE}}(z)=\rho_{\mathrm{DE}}(z)/\rho_{\mathrm{DE,0}} with Gaussian processes (GP).

arxiv-2301-04435.title: Holographic entanglement entropy in T ​ T ¯ T\overline{T} -deformed AdS 3
arxiv-2301-04435.description: Abstract In this work, we study the holographic entanglement entropy in AdS 3 gravity with the certain mixed boundary condition, which turns out to correspond to T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} -deformed 2D CFTs. By employing the Chern-Simons formalism and Wilson line technique, the holographic entanglement entropy in T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} -deformed BTZ black hole is obtained.

arxiv-2307-06659.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of Blockchain Applications for Securing Computer Vision Systems
arxiv-2307-06659.creator: Ramalingam M 1 , Chemmalar Selvi G 1 , Nancy Victor 1 , Rajeswari Chengoden 1 , Sweta Bhattacharya 1 , Praveen Kumar Reddy Maddikunta 1 Duehee Lee 2 , Md. Jalil Piran 3 , Neelu Khare 1 , Gokul Yendri 1 , Thippa Reddy Gadekallu 1 4 5 6
arxiv-2307-06659.description: Abstract Blockchain (BC) and Computer Vision (CV) are the two emerging fields with the potential to transform various sectors.The ability of BC can help in offering decentralized and secure data storage, while CV allows machines to learn and understand visual data.

arxiv-2308-11249.title: Video BagNet: short temporal receptive fields increase robustness in long-term action recognition
arxiv-2308-11249.creator: Ombretta Strafforello, Xin Liu, Klamer Schutte, Jan van Gemert
arxiv-2308-11249.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ombretta Strafforello, Xin Liu, Klamer Schutte, Jan van Gemert. Previous work on long-term video action recognition relies on deep 3D-convolutional models that have a large temporal receptive field (RF). We argue that these models are not always the best choice for temporal modeling in videos. A large temporal receptive field allows the model to encode the exact sub-action order of a video, which causes a performance decrease when testing videos have a different sub-action order.

arxiv-2309-10517.title: Love or Hate? Share or Split? Privacy-Preserving Training Using Split Learning and Homomorphic Encryption
arxiv-2309-10517.creator: 1 st Tanveer Khan, 2 nd Khoa Nguyen, 3 rd Antonis Michalas, 4 th Alexandros Bakas
arxiv-2309-10517.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by 1 st Tanveer Khan, 2 nd Khoa Nguyen, 3 rd Antonis Michalas, 4 th Alexandros Bakas. Split learning (SL) is a new collaborative learning technique that allows participants, e.g. a client and a server, to train machine learning models without the client sharing raw data. In this setting, the client initially applies its part of the machine learning model on the raw data to generate activation maps and then sends them to the server to continue the training process.

arxiv-2311-04366.title: Exploring K K -Riesz and K K - g g -Riesz Bases in the Context of Hilbert Pro- C ∗ C^{*} -Modules
arxiv-2311-04366.creator: Roumaissae Eljazzar 1∗ and Mohamed Rossafi 2
arxiv-2311-04366.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Roumaissae Eljazzar 1∗ and Mohamed Rossafi 2. In the present research, we embark on a comprehensive inquiry into K K -Riesz bases and K K -g Riesz bases as they manifest within pro- C ∗ C^{*} -Hilbert modules. Adopting a unique approach, we interpret the structure of K K -Riesz bases through the lens of a bounded below operator, complemented by the prototypical orthonormal basis of the Hilbert module 𝒳 \mathcal{X} .

arxiv-2504-01556.title: Thermalization in a model of enhanced memory capacity Thanks: The present work is an improved version of chapter 4 “Thermalization Despite Correlation” of the author’s Ph.D. thesis [ 1 ] , and has neither been previously peer-reviewed nor published elsewhere.
arxiv-2504-01556.creator: Oleg Kaikov
arxiv-2504-01556.description: Abstract We study thermalization within a quantum system with an enhanced capacity to store information. This system has been recently introduced to provide a prototype model of how a black hole processes and stores information. We perform a numerical finite-size analysis of this isolated quantum system and find indications that its information-carrying subsystem approaches thermality in the large system-size limit.

arxiv-2508-04300.title: Mathematical formulation of mode-to-mode energy transfers and energy fluxes in compressible turbulence
arxiv-2508-04300.creator: Dhananjay Singh, Harshit Tiwari, Lekha Sharma, Mahendra K. Verma
arxiv-2508-04300.description: Abstract Understanding compressible turbulence is critical for modeling atmospheric, astrophysical, and engineering flows. However, compressible turbulence poses a more significant challenge than incompressible turbulence. We present a novel mathematical framework to compute mode-to-mode energy transfer rates and energy fluxes for compressible flows.

arxiv-2511-18655.title: Disc breaking and parametric instability in warped accretion discs 2024 Disc breaking and parametric instability in warped accretion discs – 3
arxiv-2511-18655.creator: Loren E. Held, Gordon I. Ogilvie
arxiv-2511-18655.description: Abstract We present the first local simulations of disc breaking/tearing in a warped accretion disc. Warps can arise due to a misalignment between the disc and the rotation axis of the central object, or a misalignment with the orbital plane of a binary (or planetary) companion.

arxiv-2511-21668.title: Through the telecom lens: Are all training samples important?
arxiv-2511-21668.creator: Shruti Bothe ∗ , Illyyne Saffar † , Aurelie Boisbunon † , Hasan Farooq ∗ , Julien Forgeat ∗ , Md Moin Uddin Chowdhury ∗ Ericsson Research Santa Clara, USA ∗ Massy, France † shruti.bothe, illyyne.saffar, aurelie.boisbunon, hasan.farooq, julien.forgeat, md.moin.uddin.chowdhury@ericsson.com
arxiv-2511-21668.description: Abstract The rise of AI in telecommunications, from optimizing Radio Access Networks to managing user experience, has sharply increased data volumes and training demands. Telecom data is often noisy, high-dimensional, costly to store, process, and label. Despite AI’s critical role, standard workflows still assume all training samples contribute equally.

arxiv-2602-08828.title: VideoVeritas : AI-Generated Video Detection via Perception Pretext Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2602-08828.creator: Hao Tan, Jun Lan, Senyuan Shi, Zichang Tan, Zijian Yu, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Jun Wan, Zhen Lei
arxiv-2602-08828.description: Abstract The growing capability of video generation poses escalating security risks, making reliable detection increasingly essential. In this paper, we introduce VideoVeritas , a framework that integrates fine-grained perception and fact-based reasoning. We observe that while current multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capacity, their granular perception ability remains limited.

pmc-11435740.title: Caffeic Acid Phenethyl Ester Administration Reduces Enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis-Induced Colitis and Tumorigenesis
pmc-11435740.creator: Soonjae Hwang, Minjeong Jo, Ju-Eun Hong, Woo-Seung Kim, Da-Hye Kang, Sang-Hyeon Yoo, Kyungsu Kang, Ki-Jong Rhee
pmc-11435740.description: The human colonic commensal enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis (ETBF) is associated with chronic colitis and colon cancer. ETBF colonization induces colitis via the Bacteroides fragilis toxin (BFT). BFT secreted by ETBF cause colon inflammation via E-cadherin cleavage/NF-κB signaling. ETBF promotes colon tumorigenesis via interleukin 17A (IL-17A)/CXCL-dependent inflammation, but its bioactive therapeutics in ETBF-promoted tumorigenesis remain unexplored.

pmc-11576548.creator: Alwa Hussien Aladia, Samar Hamdan, Ahmad Alkheder
pmc-11576548.description: Smith-Lemli-Opitz syndrome (SLOS) is a rare genetic disorder that affects cholesterol synthesis and causes various physical and mental abnormalities. The case is a 25-day-old male infant who presented with multiple congenital anomalies, such as microcephaly, facial dysmorphism, syndactyly, hypospadias, and other organ malformations. He also had severe vomiting, feeding difficulty, irritability, dehydration, and hyponatremia.

pmc-11605925.title: Evaluation of low-and middle-income countries according to cardiovascular disease risk factors by using pythagorean fuzzy AHP and TOPSIS methods
pmc-11605925.creator: Gizem Zevde Aydın, Barış Özkan
pmc-11605925.description: BackgroundCardiovascular disease risk factors play a crucial role in determining individuals’ future health status and significantly affect health. This paper aimed to address cardiovascular disease risk factors in low- and middle-income countries using multi-criteria decision-making methods. MethodsIn line with this objective, 22 evaluation criteria were identified.

pmc-11692859.title: USING CANCER SURVIVORSHIP EXPERIENCES TO INFORM CANCER ADVOCACY IN NIGERIA
pmc-11692859.creator: Chizobam Nweke, Chinelo Nduka, Runcie Chidebe, Candi Nwakasi
pmc-11692859.description: BackgroundDespite having a high cancer burden that is still rising, Nigeria, like many rapidly aging countries in sub-Saharan Africa, due to a very high burden of infectious diseases, is not paying adequate attention to non-communicable diseases, especially cancer. This study explored the experiences of cancer survivors for informing tailored cancer advocacy programs in Nigeria.

pmc-12610137.title: Beyond Staging: The Role of Pressure Ulcer Site and Multiplicity in Hospital Mortality and Length of Stay
pmc-12610137.creator: Dimitrios Zikos, Philip Eappen, Patrick A Stone
pmc-12610137.description: Highlights What are the main findings? The anatomical site and presence of multiple pressure ulcers were stronger predictors of prolonged hospital stay and increased mortality than ulcer stage alone.Certain ulcer sites, such as sacral, hip, head, buttock, and upper back, were independently associated with a higher risk of poor outcomes. pmc-12821258.creator: Fan Zhang, Chenbing Wang, Jiaxuan Ren
pmc-12821258.description: Peach (Prunus persica) seeds exhibit low natural germination rates and prolonged germination periods due to deep dormancy, which severely limits seedling propagation efficiency and industrial scalability. In this study, four treatment groups were established: CK (water), T1 (gibberellin + sodium fluoride), T2 (sodium hypochlorite), and T3 (sodium fluoride), all combined with temperature regulation.

pmc-13402726.title: Combined carcinoembryonic antigen, carbohydrate antigen 50, and neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin distinguish benign and malignant pleural effusions: a Bayesian analysis
pmc-13402726.creator: Su-Na Cha, Yan Niu, Jian-Xun Wen, Cheng Yan, Xu-Lei Hao, Wen-Jie Hou, Li Yan, Ya-Nan Xu, Wen-Qi Zheng, Zhi-De Hu
pmc-13402726.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The value of pleural fluid neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin (NGAL) in distinguishing malignant (MPE) and benign pleural effusions (BPE) remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of pleural fluid NGAL in differentiating MPE from BPE. We prospectively enrolled patients presenting with undiagnosed pleural effusion at the Affiliated Hospital of Inner Mongolia Medical University between September 2018 and July 2021. Their pleural fluid NGAL levels were measured using a Luminex platform.
